pr_title: Use ISNULL in conjunction or filters
pr_body:
Fixes https://github.com/duckdblabs/duckdb-internal/issues/3838
Fixes https://github.com/duckdb/duckdb/issues/15479

When adding support for OR filters in table filter scans, we forgot to check for NULL in the conjunction OR.

issue_context.title: INTERNAL Error: ConstantFilter constant cannot be NULL - use IsNullFilter instead
issue_context.body:
### What happens?

The below test case triggered an internal error in DuckDB.

### To Reproduce

```sql
CREATE TABLE  t0(c1 INT);
SELECT * FROM t0 WHERE ((t0.c1 IS DISTINCT FROM NULL) OR (NOT NULL));
```

Ubuntu 22.04

review_comments: Same here, this should be only `NOT DISTINCT FROM`
`x = NULL` always returns `NULL` (i.e. false) -  so this should be only `DISTINCT FROM`

Should this mean that the table scan should just be replaced with an empty result? Since `= NULL` evaluates to NULL and as a where condition this means no rows are returned. Although for nested types NULL comparisons get tricky, but we don't support NULL pushdown into nested types yet
Yes, that's also a possible optimization, it is indeed always false
Turns out Postgres/sqlite both evaluate `WHERE NULL or TRUE` to TRUE, so `(a = NULL OR TRUE)` should not be replaced with an empty result.
Yes, that's SQL standard boolean logic (similarly `FALSE AND NULL` also returns `FALSE`).
